title: Stabilize Playwright UI route contracts and accessible selectors after web UI drift
observed_behavior: Inference and Settings smoke specs used ambiguous heading locators after route content added matching subsection headings.
Dashboard smoke expected a desktop Bahia logo at least 60px tall while the nav rendered 40px.
Soul provisioning smoke tests targeted legacy wizard labels and IDs after the route became a runtime-aware signed draft and provisioning flow.
Navigation smoke observed console errors when tests advertised no relay-backed read-model capability.
intended_behavior: Routes expose stable accessible headings and controls without ambiguous current-step state.
Soul provisioning remains signer-first, saves signed 31952 draft checkpoints, publishes 5950 provisioning requests, and verifies relay OK acceptance/rejection.
UI smoke tests seed canonical relay-backed read-model events instead of depending on legacy-kind runtime hydration.
Navigation renders against a relay-backed mock discovery contract without unexpected console errors.
